placements.why: This document revises the archive retention rule that the call settled. src-1 replaces the eighteen-month figure with twelve months, and src-3 restates that transcripts stay permanent. The settled-arrangements position is revised in place, so the existing leaf still holds it.

mints.name: QuillmoorArchiveRetention
mints.title: How long the Quillmoor archive keeps raw field recordings and transcripts
mints.why: The settled retention rule and its twelve-month revision both concern one subject: how long recordings and transcripts are kept. Later retention or consent changes can accrue here.

connections.why: The position's revised members carry the recordings-twelve-months and transcripts-permanent rules, which are about Quillmoor retention.

unconnected.why: The leaf is about how arrangements become settled by ratification across several unrelated items, so the retention stratum does not hold it as a whole.
